observations: Stainless steel gas cooker with a top oven.
Four gas burners: two standard and two larger ones.
Five control knobs on the front panel.
The oven door is open in photos 0 and 2, showing a single wire rack.
The glass top is reflective and shows some smudges or dirt.

claims.evidence: The glass top has visible smudges and the interior is not shown in detail.
No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.
The unit is shown standing on its own legs.
The unit has four gas burners and an oven.
No photo shows the burners or oven in operation.

risks.risk: Burners may be faulty or leaking gas.
risks.proof: A video showing all four burners lit and burning steadily.

risks.risk: Oven may not heat or have a broken thermostat.
risks.proof: A video of the oven heating up with a thermometer.

risks.risk: The unit may be missing a gas hose or regulator.
risks.proof: A photo of the back of the unit showing the gas connection.

proof_requests: Video of all four burners lit and working.
Video of the oven heating up.
Photo of the back of the unit showing the gas connections.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
